q: List the topological domains of P00533 with their start and end positions, ordered by start position.

q: Which protein is associated with cystic fibrosis? Give its accession and entry name.

q: Which pathway is protein A0AVI4 annotated in?

q: Which proteins are encoded by the gene BRCA1? Give accession and entry name.

q: Count the members of the protein kinase superfamily.

q: How many other proteins share a family with P01308?
